**About us** 
 Vibrant is building the future of autonomous real estate and construction. We build the software and hardware that automate how buildings get built and run — from construction workflows and procurement, to property and estate management, to the intelligent hardware inside the building that lets it monitor itself, decide, and act on its own. The goal is one operating layer that ties it all together at portfolio scale.
 



  





 Vibrant sits inside Fletcher Group, a vertically integrated platform spanning luxury construction, real estate development, estate management, interior design, and self\-storage. Fletcher gives us a real operating environment to build against — live projects, real homes, real customers.
 



  





**The role** 
 This role is for the backend developer who will build the software backbone underneath the platform — the APIs, integrations, billing, and automation that connect our hardware, subscriptions, ERPNext, and operating companies into one system. You will work alongside senior operators and modern AI development tooling, shipping in short cycles against real usage.
 



  





**What you will build** 



* Process automations that eliminate manual re\-entry across QuickBooks, ERPNext, project management tools, CRM, and field systems
* Payment and billing flows (Stripe, QuickBooks)
* Notification infrastructure (OneSignal or equivalent) for client, crew, and internal alerts
* API integrations with third\-party platforms we already use — our preference is to integrate existing tools rather than build from scratch
* ERPNext customization, workflows, and integration with the rest of the stack
* Internal dashboards and lightweight tools to replace spreadsheet\-based workflows



  





**Minimum requirements** 



* Working knowledge of .NET (C\#) and Python for backend development
* Experience building and consuming REST APIs
* Comfort with at least one major database (Postgres, SQL Server, or similar)
* Ability to work on code that handles payments and customer data responsibly — i.e., you take security seriously
* Proficiency with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) as part of your daily workflow



  





**Preferred** 



* Experience with ERPNext or Frappe (custom apps, DocTypes, server scripts, workflows)
* Experience with notification platforms (OneSignal, Twilio, SendGrid)
* Payments integration experience (Stripe, QuickBooks API)
* Familiarity with secrets management, secure coding practices, and basic security review processes
* Prior experience at a startup or small team with end\-to\-end feature ownership



  





**Compensation** 
 Competitive base salary with a path to equity participation for strong performers. High performers have historically moved up quickly within the group.
 


* **To apply** 
 Send a resume and links to relevant work — side projects, GitHub, prior contract work, or automations you have built in past roles.
